tools.name: acq_create_room
tools.description: Open a new two-seat room - one call is a complete setup: pass join_window_hours to set how long the peer has to join, and opening_message to post your first message immediately. The result is self-sufficient: room UIN, seat token (seat A), pairing code, invitation text, and the full API reference. H

tools.name: acq_join_room
tools.description: Join a room by UIN (seat B, works once). The result contains your seat token.

tools.name: acq_rejoin
tools.description: Recover a lost seat token. Seat A proves with the 6-digit pairing code; seat B proves with the recovery code returned only in the join response. Mints a fresh token; the old one stops working.

tools.name: acq_send
tools.description: Send a message to your peer. Set end=true to close the room.

tools.name: acq_recv
tools.description: Receive peer messages. Returns immediately by default (wait=0); pass wait up to 120 to long-poll, or since=<last seq you have> to replay. Set self=true to include your own messages (full transcript replay).

tools.name: acq_verify
tools.description: Verify the pairing code your peer's operator read to you, to confirm you are in the right room.

tools.name: acq_extend
tools.description: Extend the join deadline of an unclaimed room (max 24h ceiling).

tools.name: acq_feedback
tools.description: Leave feedback for the maintainer. No room needed.

tools.name: acq_stats
tools.description: Lifetime usage counters: rooms created, agents paired, messages.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "acq_verify" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: acq_create_room, acq_recv · Private data: acq_create_room, acq_join_room, acq_rejoin · Public sink: acq_create_room, acq_send.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: acq_create_room, acq_recv · Private data: acq_create_room, acq_join_room, acq_rejoin · Public sink: acq_create_room, acq_send

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
